title: Aadhaar Online Services
section: You can update any demographic details in Aadhaar by visiting any Aadhaar Enrolment centre If I want to submit documents through Aadhaar enrolment centre, how can I locate an Aadhaar centre? What is the charge for submitting the documents? For submission of documents at an Aadhaar centre, the applicable charge is Rs. 50. Submission of documents may also be done through myAadhaar portal . By when should I submit the documents? Aadhaar number holders are suggested to update documents in Aadhaar at least once in 10 years. Once you receive any communication in this regard, it is suggested to update the documents at an early date. I am a non-resident Indian (NRI). How can I submit the documents? You can submit the documents whenever you are in India, through online or by visiting Aadhaar Centre. How can I submit the documents? The documents can be submitted online through MyAadhaar Portal or at any Aadhaar Enrolment Centre. For a tutorial video in this regard, please click here https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1jne0KzFcF8  Content Information Published on: 30 Apr 2026 Last Updated: 02 Jul 2026 Owner: HO
